REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
WEDNESDAY - JUNE 3, 2026 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Community Development Department, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, 90703 during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Community Development Department during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to planning@cerritos.gov or by phone at (562) 916-1201 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The Commission, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 4.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to planning@cerritos.gov or by hard copy to the Community Development Department no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact City of Cerritos ADA/504 Coordinator, Drew Schneider, at (562) 916-1314 at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

Public Comments and Suggestions
This section is reserved for public comment on Consent Calendar and items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission. Verbal comments may be limited to three minutes per speaker, subject to the Chair extending to a maximum of five minutes per speaker, with a total time allotted not to exceed 45 minutes unless the Chair extends.
5.
Consent Calendar
Items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. Subject to the discretion of the Commission, there will be no separate discussion of these items. If a Commission member requests separate consideration, the item may be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.

PRESENT:  Commissioner Deepak “DJ” Jhaveri

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

3.  Roll Call

  All Members of the Planning Commission were declared present except Commissioner

  Commission.

4.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Commission, Chair Ao closed public comments.

5.  Consent Calendar

  Wednesday, May 6, 2026, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission Regular Meeting Minutes.

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Jhaveri, and seconded by Vice Chair
  Chauhan, to approve the Wednesday, May 6, 2026, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission
  Regular Meeting Minutes.

6.  Public Hearings

6A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE

  TELECOMMUNICATION FACILITY ON AN INDUSTRIAL PROPERTY. THE EXISTING
  WIRELESS FACILITY CONTAINS NINE (9) PANEL ANTENNAS, AND NINE (9) REMOTE
  RADIO UNITS MOUNTED ON THE MONOPINE FACILITY. AN EXISTING EQUIPMENT
  ENCLOSURE IS LOCATED BENEATH THE SUBJECT FACILITY THAT CONTAINS TWO
  (2) EQUIPMENT CABINETS, TWO (2) TELCO BOXES, ONE (1) AAV CABINET
  ENCLOSURE, ONE (1) PPC CABINET, AND ONE (1) GLOBAL POSITIONING ANTENNA

  16307 ARTHUR STREET, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA 90703 AND IS ZONED
  DEVELOPMENT AREA ONE (ADP-1) (APN 7010-016-022).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  A staff report was given by Associate Planner Wyman Wong. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed, providing details about the proposed renewal of Wireless
  Telecommunication Permit 2016-1(2026) (WTP 2016-1) for T-Mobile, a non-building
  monopine wireless telecommunication facility at 16307 Arthur Street, Cerritos,
  California 90703 (APN 7010-016-022).

  Discussion followed regarding the renewal process, whether wireless coverage will
  change under the proposed renewal, and whether the City had the opportunity to
  inspect the wireless facility under Chapter 22.42 – “Wireless Telecommunication” of
  the Cerritos Municipal Code.

  Chair Ao opened the public hearing. The project applicant provided further
  information to the Commission regarding the continued coverage of the existing
  facility. Seeing and hearing no other speakers wishing to address the Planning
  Commission, Chair Ao closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Reyes to approve Resolution 2026-16 and
  correct the word Verizon on page three (3) of the resolution to T-Mobile and
  seconded by Vice Chair Chauhan to waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No.
  2026-16: RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
  RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION PERMIT 2016-
  1(2026) RENEWAL, A REQUEST BY APPLICANT NETWORK CONNEX, ON BEHALF OF

7.  New and Old Business

7A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION FINDING THE PROPOSED CITY OF CERRITOS
  CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROGRAM FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026-2027 IN CONFORMITY
  WITH THE CERRITOS GENERAL PLAN.

  A staff report was given by Assistant City Engineer/Acting City Engineer Jared Lee. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed, providing background information on the
  City’s Capital Improvement Program (CIP). Mr. Lee continued his presentation,
  providing details of upcoming public improvements to government buildings, parks,
  and open spaces, sewer improvements, streets and highways, traffic signals, and
  water improvements.

  Discussion continued regarding ADA compliance as it pertains to the Cerritos Center
  for the Performing Arts accessibility ramps and handrails, project priorities, IT
  infrastructure ERP Software, sewer pipe CCTV inspections, the Del Amo Bridge,
  motor and pedestrian safety, and funding allocated toward traffic study signage.

  Chair Ao opened the public hearing. Seeing and hearing no speakers wishing to
  address the Planning Commission, Chair Ao closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Jhaveri and seconded by Commissioner
  Reyes to waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2026-17: A RESOLUTION
  OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION FINDING THE PROPOSED CITY OF
  CERRITOS CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROGRAM FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026-2027 IN
  CONFORMITY WITH THE CERRITOS GENERAL PLAN.

  The motion carried (4-0-1-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Jhaveri, Reyes, Chauhan, Ao
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Surti
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Review and consideration of a Commissioner's request to discuss existing Cerritos
  Municipal Code regulations pertaining to lighting and signage requirements for
  commercial and industrial zoned properties, pursuant to the City of Cerritos

City of Cerritos  June 3, 2026
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 3
   Commission and Committee Scope of Authority Policy (Policy 6.02).

  A brief agenda report was given by Current Planning Manager Amanda Acuña
  regarding the May 6, 2026 Planning Commission meeting, in which the Commission
  directed that the item be brought back for discussion and consideration. Ms. Acuña
  stated that Vice Chair Chauhan's original request expressed interest in reviewing and
  potentially amending the City’s existing lighting and signage regulations for
  commercial- and industrial-zoned properties. Ms. Acuña continued her report by
  stating that signage for commercial and industrial properties is regulated by Chapter
  22.48 of the Cerritos Municipal Code, as well as by Master Sign Programs established
  in close partnership with commercial and industrial property owners. She concluded
  her report by informing the Commission that, through the precise plan process, the
  City can also regulate signage on respective properties and by noting Policy No.
  6.02, “Commission and Committee Scope of Authority Policy,” in the City Policy and
  Procedure Manual.

  Discussion continued regarding the process by which the Planning Commission can
  recommend amendments to the City’s Municipal Code and General Plan, the
  frequency of updates to the City’s land use policy documents, and the addressing of
  inconsistencies through amendments to the City’s policy documents. Additional
  discussion continued on the potential costs associated with such amendments.
  Specific discussion pertaining to signage included costs of updating the City’s sign
  ordinance, new technology available for signs, and specific sign standards for specific
  Area Development Plans.

  Chair Ao opened the public hearing. Cerritos resident David Pylman expressed his
  dissatisfaction with the scope of authority of the Planning Commission. Seeing and
  hearing no speakers wishing to address the Planning Commission, Chair Ao closed
  public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Vice Chair Chauhan and seconded by Commissioner
  Reyes to define the process by which the Planning Commission can make
  suggestions to the Cerritos Municipal Code, as related to planning, beyond the scope
  of City Council Policy 6.02. Discussion ensued regarding the City’s Guidebook for
  Elected and Appointed Officials and City Council Policy 6.02.

  Vice Chair Chauhan withdrew his motion.

  MOTION: It was moved by Vice Chair Chauhan and seconded by Commissioner
  Jhaveri to direct City Council to review General Plan Policy: CD—4.2 to provide equal
  opportunity for Cerritos businesses as related to the City’s Sign Ordinance.

  The motion carried (4-0-1-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Jhaveri, Reyes, Chauhan, Ao
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Surti
  ABSTAIN:  None
